L1?.axis: liveness (separate from the safety obligations S1–S5; never an S-row)
L1?.name: recoverable succession / explicit terminalization
L1?.statement: For a Locus whose policy declares continued service, if the current holder becomes permanently unavailable and sufficient admissible loss evidence is eventually established, the system eventually (A) admits exactly one successor in a later generation, or (B) moves the Locus to an explicit terminal/quarantined state; it never remains silently ambiguous forever. L1 must not weaken S1/S2; a system may choose halt-on-loss and promise only (B).
L1?.statement_temporal_v2_5: Under weak fairness of the finality action family (finalize ∨ terminalize) — i.e. the resolver is not postponed forever while enabled — every admissibly evidenced permanent-loss state eventually reaches an explicit terminal state or a closed generation (L1-closed). Admission of exactly one successor (L1-strict, clause A) additionally requires weak fairness of attachment: an assumption on the ENVIRONMENT (a willing successor exists), not on the Locus mechanism.
L1?.status: candidate — NOT promoted (GPT v3 §11); L1-PRE + a temporal witness under declared fairness; TLC twin unexecuted

witnesses.label: L1 temporal witness under a DECLARED fairness policy (v2.7: offer / enable / attach; eventuality-failing vocabulary)

witnesses.fairness: declared: WF(finality) for L1-closed; WF(finality)+WF(offer)+WF(enable)+WF(attach) for L1-service-succession (ENV-SUCCESSOR-AVAILABILITY = WF(offer), SYS-SUCCESSOR-ENABLEMENT = WF(enable), SYS-ATTACH-FAIRNESS = WF(attach)); every proper subset fails; SF(finality) ≡ WF(finality); NONE admits the postponement counterexample

L1?.finding_v2_5: the successor clause (A) of L1 is an environment-liveness assumption; only the closure/terminalization clause is a property of the Locus mechanism alone. Weak fairness of the DISJUNCTION finalize ∨ terminalize is the minimal obligation (Specifying Systems §8.6: weaker than WF of each). — refined in v2.6 (GPT v3 §10): WF(attach) mixed two assumptions; the model now separates ENV-SUCCESSOR from SYS-ATTACH-FAIRNESS and shows neither alone guarantees succession.
mechanism_instances_seen: cd-core FinalityWarden + LossBasis (evidence-gated closure of a generation)
L1?.statement_temporal_v2_6: L1-closed (a SYSTEM guarantee): under weak fairness of the finality action family (finalize ∨ terminalize), every admissibly evidenced permanent-loss state eventually reaches an explicit terminal state or a closed generation. L1-service-succession (a system guarantee CONDITIONAL on two assumptions): admission of exactly one successor additionally requires ENV-SUCCESSOR — eventually a valid willing successor is offered (the environment; the Locus cannot manufacture one) — AND SYS-ATTACH-FAIRNESS — a continuously enabled valid attachment is not postponed forever (the system/scheduler). Neither alone suffices (executed: witnesses/liveness_l1_fair.py).
L1?.vocabulary_v2_6: resolvable = a resolution path exists (L1-PRE; fairness ignored) · eventuality-failing = a fair non-resolving execution exists ("eventual resolution not guaranteed") · UNRESOLVABLE is reserved for states with NO path (the NO-FINALITY variant only). A resolvable state is never called unresolvable because temporal eventuality fails.
L1?.statement_temporal_v2_7: L1-closed (a SYSTEM guarantee): under weak fairness of the finality action family, every admissibly evidenced permanent-loss state eventually reaches an explicit terminal state or a closed generation. L1-service-succession (a system guarantee CONDITIONAL on three assumptions): admission of exactly one successor additionally requires ENV-SUCCESSOR-AVAILABILITY (an eligible, willing candidate exists and is offered — the environment), SYS-SUCCESSOR-ENABLEMENT (after valid finality and a valid offer, the system establishes or recognizes the authority/policy state that makes at least one successor attachment admissible — a system/mechanism obligation), and SYS-ATTACH-FAIRNESS (once that admissible attachment remains enabled, the scheduler/control plane does not postpone it forever). Omitting any one leaves a fair non-resolving execution (executed: witnesses/liveness_l1_fair.py v2.7).
L1?.finding_v2_7: GPT v4 §12: v2.6 enabled attach automatically once a successor was offered, hiding the system obligation to make the offered successor ADMISSIBLE (authority, grant, policy, generation/finality proof, resource compatibility, world/locus admission). The model now refines succession into offer / enable / attach; the "both" policy of v2.6 (offer + attach fair, no enablement) now FAILS — the third assumption is not hidden inside "valid offer".

FAC-CONTROL-SENSITIVITY.axis: factory epistemic invariant / evidence-admission rule (not S1–S5; not liveness)
FAC-CONTROL-SENSITIVITY.statement: A control may promote an evidence class only if its sensitivity to the claimed forbidden state is itself evidenced — at least one of: (A) pre-fix or injected-fault execution demonstrates FAIL; (B) an independent witness demonstrates that the control reaches the intended subject and discriminates the forbidden state; (C) a mutation/negative-control pair proves that removing the target mechanism flips the verdict. A green-only control with no demonstrated failure sensitivity cannot support promotion.
FAC-CONTROL-SENSITIVITY.corollary: the runner/receipt machinery that records a control must itself have a negative control capable of making the aggregate fail
